en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a grand public square, framed by ornate multi-story buildings with detailed façades. In the center is a prominent monument or fountain, surrounded by gardens and well-kept walking paths. The background shows hills. The bottom of the front side includes Swedish text identifying the place, and there is handwritten correspondence. The back is addressed to 'Herr John Wögberg' at 'Lasarettgatan 7, Örnsköldsvik' and has a postmark indicating early 20th century.
